description: Replace the background of one car photo with a chosen scene: the main tool for turning a phone photo into a listing photo. The car is kept as photographed and gets shadows, lighting and reflections that match the scene. Works on exterior, interior and detail shots. Pick `background_id` with list_backgrounds first and use the same one for every photo of a car. In the same call it can hide the plate (`hide_license_plate`, with `license_plate_style` and, for `logo`, a `license_plate_logo` from list_logos), draw a dealer `logo`, reframe to an `aspect_ratio`, centre the car or show it washed. To hide the plate without changing the background use hide_license_plates; to make a new scene use create_background. One photo per call; the source photo is not modified. Costs one credit, and a failed generation is not charged. Can take up to a minute. Returns a signed `image_url` of the high-resolution result, valid for 7 days.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Omit to keep the photo's own.

center_car.description: Experimental: centre, enlarge and level the car like a listing photo.

clean_car.description: Experimental: show the car freshly washed.

hide_license_plate.description: Hide a legible license plate (exterior photos).

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the car photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

id.description: A plate logo `id` from list_logos with type `plate`.

license_plate_style.description: With hide_license_plate: `plain` (default) replaces it with a blank plate, `blur` blurs it, `logo` shows the dealer's plate logo (set license_plate_logo).

logo.description: Draw one of the workspace's logos on the result.

name: generate_background
title: Replace photo background
